AN ORDINANCE OF THE COUNCIL OF SANTA CLAUS, GEORGIA AUTHORIZING JUDICIAL IN REM TAX FORECLOSURES

WHEREAS, the General Assembly of the State of Georgia has found that the nonpayment of ad valorem taxes places a greater burden on taxpayers who do pay, creates barriers to neighborhood and urban revitalization, and allows significant delinquency that hampers marketability and insurability of property; and

WHEREAS, the Council of Santa Claus desires to improve the allocation of ad valorem taxes, improve marketability and insurability of property, decrease safety hazards associated with delinquent properties, and return certain tax delinquent properties to the tax rolls and into productive use; and

WHEREAS, the General Assembly of this State enacted Article 5, Chapter 4, Title 48 of the Official Code of Georgia, providing for judicial in rem tax foreclosures of tax executions; and

WHEREAS, 0.C.G.A. § 48-4-76(a) provides that governing authorities of counties and municipalities may proceed with judicial in rem tax foreclosures for delinquent taxes upon enacting an Ordinance or Resolution authorizing the use of such procedures; and

WHEREAS, the Mayor and Council of Santa Claus desire to adopt such resolution to authorize judicial in rem tax foreclosure proceedings as an additional tool for collection of delinquent taxes;

NOW THEREFORE, BE IT RESOLVED, pursuant to and as authorized by 0.C.G.A.
